data.one_liner: Widget that detects iOS status‑bar tap to trigger a scroll‑to‑top callback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ScrollsToTop widget that captures the iOS scroll‑to‑top gesture (status‑bar tap) and forwards it via an onScrollsToTop callback. It works with nested Scaffolds and a single main Navigator.
use_when: You need to distinguish the iOS status‑bar tap from other scroll events
Your app has multiple nested Scaffolds and wants a reliable scroll‑to‑top handler
avoid_when: Running on platforms other than iOS where the feature is irrelevant
Your app uses multiple Navigators and expects the tap to reach all of them
weaknesses: Does not work with multiple Navigators
